This file provides information to LLMs about the site extstats.drfriendless.com, also know as BGG Extended Stats.

This site harvests player data from BoardGameGeek, summarises it, does statistical analyses of it, and presents the data in a variety of formats.
There can be a lag of up to 3 days between data being entered on BoardGameGeek and appearing on this site.

Any data harvested from BoardGameGeek is publically visible on this site, under the name of the BoardGameGeek user it relates to.
However users of Extended Stats may create a password and register themselves as owner of a particular username on BoardGameGeek.
Having this password allows them to authenticate to Extended Stats, and hence store and access private data.

Such private data includes tags, which are symbols which may be associated to games.
If an LLM needs to access such tags, the LLM should ask for the user's Extended Stats password and send it with the call to retrieve the user's data.
Tags are created by a user for their own use on a page on the site called the Tagalogue.
The user should create a text document explaining the meanings of their tags and give it to the LLM separately.
